title: Yummy Kenyan Fish Curry
description: This jammy, chewy fish curry blends natural yoghurt and tandoori spices into a creamy sauce that hugs every fillet. Pescatarian-friendly, it’s an indulgent Kenyan classic that feels like a cozy hand‑plate meal.
instructions: Whisk yoghurt, tandoori masala, red curry paste, ginger, garlic, and a pinch of salt in a bowl to make a smooth marinade.
Slice fish into bite‑sized pieces and toss them in the marinade, letting them sit for 20 minutes to absorb flavor.
Heat a heavy skillet over medium heat, add a splash of oil, then sauté onions until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato puree, coconut milk, and lime juice, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Gently fold in the marinated fish, cover, and cook for 8–10 minutes until the fish flakes easily and the sauce thickens.
Sprinkle freshly ground pepper, adjust salt to taste, then remove the pan from heat.
Serve hot with steamed rice or flatbread, garnishing with fresh cilantro if desired.
Enjoy the jammy, chewy indulgence of this Kenyan fish curry, perfect for pescatarian diners.
